import nanosurf

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Access components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm

scan.Lines = 128  # Lines per frame

zcontrol.PGain = 3100
zcontrol.IGain = 3500

# Start the scan

for _ in range(3):
    scan.StartFrameUp()

# Clean up
spm = None
del spm

import time

#load application

application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

# Start scan
